d: 'Where is Trump? Where is Macron?' Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva aims at world leaders as COP31 descends into a fierce battle over climate finance. Developing nations are demanding billions to tackle climate change, while wealthy countries face mounting questions over their commitments. An emerging climate deal has sparked fresh anger, with divisions over fossil fuels, funding and who should bear the cost of the energy transition. With Australia leading negotiations despite its massive coal and gas exports, is climate justice slipping off the agenda? Gurshheen Gahllen…
